howToPlay: Use Shelly's gadgets to maneuver or extend your reach. Utilize Shell Shock to slow enemies down or Band-Aid to recover health quickly. Close the distance to maximize your damage output.
gears: Equip SPEED to navigate the map, DAMAGE to increase output when low on health, and SHIELD for extra survivability.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who excel at aggressive close-range encounters and defensive sustain.
